# Completed maintainer-recorded merge direction round: 3 SQL observations, 584 hex cells.
# Follow-up to tools/kll/sampler_updates.answers.txt; findings: tools/kll/merge_order.md.
# Archived BigQuery bytes, not golden writer expectations. Do not regenerate.

# Reverse the two source inputs of the earlier mixed-cutoff grid.
# Labels a/b still refer to low/high cutoff, not input position.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(a, b, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY a, b, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT low_state.w AS a, high_state.w AS b, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(0 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010001803') AS s),
    STRUCT(1 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010011803') AS s),
    STRUCT(2 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010021803') AS s),
    STRUCT(3 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010031803') AS s),
    STRUCT(4 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010041803') AS s),
    STRUCT(5 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010051803') AS s),
    STRUCT(6 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010061803') AS s),
    STRUCT(7 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803') AS s)]) AS low_state,
       UNNEST([STRUCT(0 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10001804') AS s),
    STRUCT(1 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10011804') AS s),
    STRUCT(2 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10021804') AS s),
    STRUCT(3 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10031804') AS s),
    STRUCT(4 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10041804') AS s),
    STRUCT(5 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10051804') AS s),
    STRUCT(6 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10061804') AS s),
    STRUCT(7 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10071804') AS s),
    STRUCT(8 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10081804') AS s),
    STRUCT(9 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10091804') AS s),
    STRUCT(10 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f100a1804') AS s),
    STRUCT(11 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f100b1804') AS s),
    STRUCT(12 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f100c1804') AS s),
    STRUCT(13 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f100d1804') AS s),
    STRUCT(14 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f100e1804') AS s),
    STRUCT(15 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f100f1804') AS s)]) AS high_state,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST([high_state.s, low_state.s]) AS s
  GROUP BY a, b, trial
)

# Nonempty/zero-weight sampler controls, one-input and both input orders.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(variant, direction, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY variant, direction, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT low_state.variant, direction, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('pending_7' AS variant, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803') AS s),
    STRUCT('pending_0' AS variant, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010001803') AS s)]) AS low_state,
       UNNEST(['identity', 'low_first', 'high_first']) AS direction,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(CASE direction
         WHEN 'identity' THEN [low_state.s]
         WHEN 'low_first' THEN [low_state.s, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10001804')]
         ELSE [FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10001804'), low_state.s]
       END) AS s
  GROUP BY variant, direction, trial
)

# Absent sampler controls, isolated so rejection cannot hide the other grids.
# Field 6 removed and payload length corrected; other state fields unchanged.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(variant, direction, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY variant, direction, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT low_state.variant, direction, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('no_sampler' AS variant, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a071b080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a03120104') AS s)]) AS low_state,
       UNNEST(['identity', 'low_first', 'high_first']) AS direction,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(CASE direction
         WHEN 'identity' THEN [low_state.s]
         WHEN 'low_first' THEN [low_state.s, FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10001804')]
         ELSE [FROM_HEX('0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10001804'), low_state.s]
       END) AS s
  GROUP BY variant, direction, trial
)
